definitions.explanation: A designated place where people can take refuge during disasters such as earthquakes, typhoons, or floods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{避難所|ひなんじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: After the earthquake, we headed to the evacuation shelter.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{避難所|ひなんじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The nearby school is designated as an evacuation shelter.

examples.japanese: {避難所|ひなんじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{数日間|すうじつかん}⟦{生活|せいかつ}した→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed at the evacuation shelter for several days.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧ (evacuation) + {所|じょ} (place)

TYPES:
- ⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧{避難所|ひなんじょ} - designated evacuation shelter
- ⟦{広域|こういき}→広域：12533_kouiki⟧{避難所|ひなんじょ} - wide-area evacuation site
- ⟦{一時|いちじ}→一時：01799_ichiji⟧{避難所|ひなんじょ} - temporary evacuation shelter

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {避難所|ひなんじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}する→避難する：26827_hinansuru⟧ (to evacuate to a shelter)
- {避難所|ひなんじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開設|かいせつ}する→開設する：30272_kaisetsusuru⟧ (to open a shelter)
- {避難所|ひなんじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ (to spend time at a shelter)
- {避難所|ひなんじょ}⟦{運営|うんえい}→運営：05096_unei⟧ (shelter management)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, schools and community centers are often designated as {避難所|ひなんじょ}. Due to frequent earthquakes and typhoons, knowing your local evacuation shelter is part of disaster preparedness. Signs with 「{避難所|ひなんじょ}」 are common.
